hook: When I say I want to do life with you, I mean:
emotional_obstacle: The desire to do life together can sound abstract unless small rituals make it visible.
reader_mirror: The viewer wants the ordinary future with their person.
aachu_proof: Aachu's presence appears through expressive hands, hair, side/back posture, and playful reactions.
zuv_active_role: Zuv participates in each ritual instead of being a background partner.
bridge: The deck moves from soft domestic rituals to playful sock-throwing so the love feels lived.
earned_ending: The final line is not grand romance; it is choosing the little chaos together.
send_save_reason: It is an exact soft message someone can send to the person they want to build the boring parts with.
